projects.title: INVOINET
projects.description: Repositioned enterprise fintech for regional expansion and rebuilt platform in React

details.problem: Invoinet, a fintech serving 40+ enterprise clients, needed to reposition for regional expansion. Their website messaging was misaligned with their evolved product, causing wrong prospect expectations and low enterprise credibility.
approach: Led user research with enterprise clients to redefine positioning strategy
Designed UX/UI and information architecture for enterprise audience
Built entire frontend from scratch in React (first solo production app)
Deployed to Azure and managed release
results: ✓ Clarified value proposition enabling sales team to qualify leads better
✓ Positioned as enterprise-grade solution for regional expansion
✓ Page load optimized and improved conversion rate

projects.title: JUNTOZ
projects.description: E-commerce marketplace redesign: rebuilt Seller Center from user research to production.

details.problem:
Juntoz, a leading Peruvian e-commerce marketplace recently acquired by EFE Group, was losing sellers to competitors like Amazon Seller Central and Mercado Libre.

The Seller Center was built without user research, making it extremely difficult for sellers to create and manage their virtual stores. Sellers abandoned the platform and chose competitors with more intuitive seller experiences—directly impacting marketplace growth.

Product challenge: redesign the Seller Center to match or exceed competitor usability, enabling sellers to onboard and operate independently without friction.
results: ✓ Redesigned Seller Center from ground up based on comprehensive user research
✓ Matched competitor usability standards enabling independent seller operations
✓ Improved seller onboarding and retention rates
✓ Reduced seller support tickets through intuitive interface design

theChallenge.paragraph1: Juntoz, a leading Peruvian e-commerce marketplace recently acquired by EFE Group, was losing sellers to competitors like Amazon Seller Central and Mercado Libre.
theChallenge.coreProblem: The Seller Center was built without user research, making it extremely difficult for sellers to create and manage their virtual stores. Sellers abandoned the platform and chose competitors with more intuitive seller experiences—directly impacting marketplace growth.
theChallenge.productGoal: Redesign the Seller Center to match or exceed competitor usability, enabling sellers to onboard and operate independently without friction.

productResearch.userResearch: In-depth interviews across seller segments (small/large merchants) and internal stakeholders to understand pain points
productResearch.competitiveBenchmarking: Analyzed Linio, Shopstar, Ripley, Mercado Libre, Amazon Seller Central to identify usability best practices and feature gaps
productResearch.keyInsight: Competitors had significantly better onboarding flows and self-service management tools

informationArchitecture.description: Restructured platform with 12 core modules designed for seller self-service:
informationArchitecture.modules: Dashboard, Catálogo, Pedidos, Envíos, Diseña tu tienda, Marketing, Logística, Calificaciones, Integraciones, Notificaciones, Configuración, Beneficios

items: Created wireframes and high-fidelity prototypes in Figma
Tested with internal team and select sellers before development

projects.title: SHIFT
projects.description: Positioning strategy and website for innovation community connecting corporate leaders with entrepreneurial ecosystem.

details.problem:
SHIFT was launching an innovation community with a unique but difficult positioning challenge: serve two distinct audiences simultaneously.

Corporate leaders needed exposure to innovation and entrepreneurial thinking. Entrepreneurs needed ccess to corporate decision-makers and resources.

Challenge: position SHIFT as the connective tissue between these worlds in a market where competitors served one OR the other—and build a website that spoke to both audiences without alienating either
results: 🚀 40% increase in membership inquiries within first month
🔎 Brand recognition improved by 65% in target demographic
💡 Website conversion rate increased from 2.1% to 8.3%

projects.title: WORTHIT
projects.description: Venture capital platform for early-stage B2B SaaS startups, differentiating through strategic corporate connections.

details.problem:
WorthIt, a newly launched venture capital fund, needed to differentiate in a crowded LatAm VC market.

Their unique value wasn't just capital—it was strategic connections to enterprise clients that accelerate product-market fit.

Product challenge: build a digital platform that communicated this differentiation to two user segments (founders seeking investment, investors seeking co-investment opportunities) while establishing credibility as a new fund.
results: 🎯 Clear dual-path user experience serving both founders and investors
📊 Effective communication of complex investment thesis and criteria
🚀 Established credible digital presence for newly launched VC fund
💼 Streamlined conversion flows for each user segment

projects.title: NGROWTH

📈 Created scalable website foundation for future growth
